newsitem.title: USA: Dow gathers steam to trade at 8,000, techs lead.
newsitem.headline: Dow gathers steam to trade at 8,000, techs lead.

text.p: The Dow industrials shrugged off early losses in component Eastman Kodak Co to trade around the record 8,000 level on Wednesday, taking leadership from a powerful technology sector.

The Dow Jones Industrial average rose around 26 points to 8,002. It made an early push across the 8,000 mark, then retreated when Kodak opened lower following the company's release of below-forecast second quarter results.
But the Dow recouped these losses, firming as the technology sector extended its mighty rally. The Nasdaq composite gained 24 points, or 1.57 percent, to 1566.
The long bond also added impetus to equities markets, touching a 6.50 percent yield, its lowest since December 1996.
Markets were helped by the release of the June consumer price index, whose 0.1 percent rise pointed to tame inflation.

"The path of least resistance is up," John Cleland, chief investment strategist at Security Benefit Group of Cos, said. "There are no potential bombshells on the horizon which are likely to derail us. Buckle your seatbelts."
Technology stocks bolted up on the back of chipmaker Intel Corp, which posted second quarter results of $0.92 per share versus a First Call consensus estimate of $0.90.
